summary: Shop Tabs bulk assignment feature (Managers workspace) — backend 5/5 pytest passed and full UI round-trip verified on /admin/materials. GET /api/supplier-sync/shop-tab-destinations returns Tiles page with exactly 7 tabs / 3 assignable (WALL/FLOOR/PORCELAIN mapped to Wall Tiles/Floor Tiles/Porcelain) and Flooring page with VINYL+LAMINATE assignable. Non-assignable tabs (ALL TILES, POLISHED, MATT, SALE, ALL FLOORING) correctly dimmed with 'automatic — shows everything in this Manager'. POST /api/supplier-sync/products/assign-shop-tabs add/remove round-trip on LP-6611 confirmed to mutate sub_categories in supplier_products (verified via /supplier-sync/products) and 400 validation on empty skus + no-changes. Storefront /api/tiles/collections?category=porcelain reflects new assignment (TestSeries appears after add). UI: bulk bar shows bar-shop-tabs button between Unpublish and Reassign as required; modal renders both pages with correct tri-state (green tick / amber minus / empty), summary '+1 destination' works, Apply button gates on changes, success toast 'N product(s) updated — live on the website now' fires and modal closes. Re-opening after apply shows PORCELAIN as green (all) confirming persistence. Untick+Apply successfully restores. LP-6611 sub_categories restored to baseline ['Large Format','Floor Tiles','Matt'].

issues: Minor: when clicking a currently-green (pre-existing 'all') tab to untick it, the change-summary occasionally still reads '+1 destination' instead of the expected '−1 removed' text during the same-session tri-state cycle. The Apply itself works correctly (backend removes the category) and the reopen shows the tab as empty — the numerical summary label is just misleading. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Verify ShopTabsAssignModal change-summary text reflects a green→empty transition as '−1 removed' rather than '+1 destination' when the pre-existing state was 'all'. Likely a sign/count in the summary useMemo.
critical_code_review_comments: assign_shop_tabs: 'updated' count is taken from supplier_products.matched_count only; when the same SKU exists in the tiles collection but not in supplier_products, the response reports updated:0 despite a real tiles write. Consider Math.max of both matched_counts.
assign_shop_tabs writes to BOTH supplier_products and tiles unconditionally — good for storefront freshness, but there is no transactional rollback if the second write fails. Non-critical for MVP.

get_shop_tab_destinations falls back to hard-coded default tiles menu when navigation_menus doc missing — kept in sync with website_admin.py; if that default drifts they will diverge. Consider extracting the default into a shared constant.
supplier_sync.py is very large (>14k lines) — Shop Tabs endpoints would be cleaner in a dedicated router module.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@test.com / admin123 at /admin/login (from review request)

During UI run, Porcelain was added to 3 sample rows in Materials Manager (Premium Oak Series children) and then removed via the same modal; final DB state matches pre-test baseline for LP-6611.

Only nit is a summary label transition text; no functional bug.
